summary: Frontend-only verification of Home->reader morph transition bug fix on /discover and /deep-dive/[id] (viewport 390x844, guest session). All 6 acceptance groups PASS: (1) Open transition shows story-morph-title/badges bounding rects progressing across 150/400/650ms (no freeze), morph-host disappears cleanly, URL correctly becomes /deep-dive/<id>?morph=1&rect=..., chapters + end mount within ~1.2s. (2) Close from intro returns to /discover with morph-host count=0 (repeated x2 with same card, both clean). (3) Close from chapter 1 (after wheel to 01/06) returns cleanly to /discover with morph-host count=0. (4) Reader paging regression: 6 wheel notches produce exact scrollTop sequence 788/1568/2348/3128/3908/4688 and end reached (deep-dive-page-end visible). (5) Direct open ?start=1 on fresh state lands at scrollTop=821 (~788), header 01/06, chapter-1 mounted immediately. (6) Home renders deck (2 cards visible), no error overlay. Zero console errors and zero pageerrors across all flows. Reanimated 'linear easing fallback on web' warning present (expected, per request note).

Sampled story-morph-badges rects: y=73 -> 103.69 -> 369.92 and w=307.73 -> 342 -> 342 (progressing to grid target). Both title & badges show monotonic bounding rect changes across frames -> no freeze/snap. morph-host count after ~1.9s = 0 (removed cleanly). deep-dive-intro visible=True; deep-dive-page-chapter-1 and deep-dive-page-end present in DOM ~1.2s after commit. 0 console errors, 0 pageerrors.

critical_code_review_comments: story-morph.tsx L38 MORPH_EASING = Easing.inOut(Easing.sin) applied; on web Reanimated falls back to linear (per attached note) - visually acceptable, real device smoothness cannot be measured here.
story-morph.tsx L43 OPEN_COMMIT_AT=0.86 defers reader mount to 86% of the run; verified morph-host disappears cleanly (0 leaks across 3 open/close cycles).
story-morph.tsx L46 CLOSE_FADE_MS=150 + fadeTimer scheduling at MORPH_DURATION-CLOSE_FADE_MS ensures overlay fades during last 150ms; observed clean fade with no snap at arrival.

deep-dive/[id].tsx L86-91 chaptersReady defers chapter/ending/share-card mount when morph=1 (setTimeout 40ms after morphHost.active becomes false). For start=1 or morph!='1', chaptersReady starts true - verified chapter-1 mounted immediately in direct-open test.
morph-host.tsx L42-44 dismiss uses Easing.out(Easing.quad) over 150ms + runOnJS(clear) - matches CLOSE_FADE_MS, coherent teardown.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The bug-fix verification for the story-morph title/grid freeze is complete on web. Key facts: (1) morph testIDs: 'morph-host' (top-level overlay), 'story-morph', 'story-morph-title', 'story-morph-badges', 'story-morph-cover'. (2) On open, home cards use data-testid pattern 'home-story-<id>-open'; URL after tap has ?morph=1&rect=x,y,w,h. (3) On close, click [data-testid=reader-back] from intro OR any chapter - morph-host mounts a 'close' StoryMorph and disappears within ~1.5s. (4) On web, Reanimated logs 'Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' - this is expected and does NOT indicate a bug. (5) Reading progress persists in localStorage; when regression-testing ?start=1, clear reading progress keys via addInitScript, otherwise resume overrides start. (6) reader-back on morph=1 flow calls morphBack(x) which shows a StoryMorph with direction=close; no morph if !backRect or !router.canGoBack.
rca_of_issue: N/A - bug fix verified working. Freeze-before-snap eliminated: title and badges bounding rects progress smoothly across 150/400/650ms samples without discontinuity, and morph-host fades out cleanly during the last 150ms of the transition.
